prs.location: U Citywest Demesne is located at the heart of Citywest and within easy reach of a host of amenities. The LUAS is on the doorstep, and several bus routes pass by on Citywest Road. The development is located across the road from Citywest Shopping Centre, where there's a variety of shops and restaurants, including Dunnes Stores. There's a range of sports and recreational facilities nearby, and a primary school literally across the road.

description:
U Citywest Demesne is a fabulous development of luxury homes, located beside numerous amenities & schools. The redbrick Edwardian style houses take their inspiration from Dublin's redbrick streetscapes, and the Demesne has a beautiful landscaped 'village green' at the heart of the estate. These homes are all generously proportioned and are fully finished with high quality kitchens (including appliances) and bathrooms. The quality finish is complimented by bespoke U furniture and finishes throughout. 


*Our team will endeavour to respond to all enquiries. However, this may not be possible in all cases due to the high volume of interest for the property and we wish you all the best with your property search.*

*Photos for reference only. No pets allowed*
